summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 資料中心基礎設施需求強勁與自由現金流成長預期，Quanta Services 展現長期成長潛力。

bullish.title: Quanta Targets Up to $2.5B FCF: Can Cash Momentum Stay Strong?

bullish.title: 3 Stocks Already Winning the OpenAI vs. Anthropic Race

bullish.title: Why Quanta Services Stock Flew Higher on Friday

bullish.title: Buy 5 Growth Stocks to Boost Your Portfolio in Q4 After a Mixed Q3
